title: Reading Person Profiles, Citations & Audio
style: Warm, clear archival museum narrator at a calm, unhurried pace.

steps.title: Read vital facts, evidence badges, and Life Timeline
steps.posterAlt: Abraham Lincoln Person Profile displaying vital dates, family connections, and cited timeline milestones.

cues.text: Open any Person Profile, such as Abraham Lincoln, to read vital facts, immediate family connections, and the chronological Life Timeline.
Green Cited badges mark facts backed by primary documents, while amber Family memory badges flag oral tradition still awaiting a source.

steps.title: Inspect original scans in the Source Reader
steps.posterAlt: Evidence and Sources view showing the Source Registry and citation links for the Lincoln and Todd archive.

cues.text: Select any citation pill to open the Source Inspector, or browse the Source Registry in Evidence and Sources.
Use Text, Side-by-Side, and Original Scan modes in the Source Reader to verify transcriptions directly against record scans.

steps.title: Play Pronunciation Guides and narrated biographies
steps.posterAlt: Person Profile header featuring Pronunciation Guide audio control and narrative biography section.

cues.text: When a historic name includes a Pronunciation Guide, press the speaker button beside the heading to hear how the name is spoken.
Narrated biographies play inline and stay active in the persistent bottom dock while you explore other records.
